admin.title: Manage items
admin.intro: Changes are saved on the server and show up straight away in the site's catalogue.
admin.loading: Loading… (up to a minute if the server was asleep)
admin.confirmText: The item is permanently deleted from the API. To only take it off sale, untick “Available” instead.
admin.fLabelHelp: 2 lines max, separated by “/” (e.g. NOTEBOOK / 200 PAGES)
admin.fImageHelp: Local path, e.g. img/produits/notebook.webp (file in public/img/produits/)
admin.errImage: Local path starting with img/ (.webp, .avif, .png, .jpg or .svg photo).
admin.errEn: Fill in both the English name and description, or neither.
admin.usersIntro: An employee clocks in from “My account”. A manager also manages orders, and sees and corrects the team's hours (not their own). An administrator also manages products and accounts. A blocked account can no longer log in. The last administrator cannot be demoted, blocked or deleted.
admin.confirmUserText: The account is deleted permanently. An account with recorded hours cannot be deleted: block it instead.
admin.errHasHours: This account has recorded hours; deleting it would erase that history. Block it instead.
admin.importTitle: Import items from a CSV file
admin.importHelp: The easiest way: export the current catalogue, edit it in Excel, save it as CSV and import it. You get a preview before anything is saved.
admin.importColumns: Columns: id, categorie (Scolaire, Bureau or Livres), prix (FCFA, empty = on request), nom, famille, description, vignette, nom_en, description_en, vignette_en, couleur (#RRGGBB), disponible (oui / non), image (img/produits/…), stock. Only nom and categorie are required for a new item.
admin.importRules: A row with an id updates that item; without an id it updates the item with the same name, otherwise it creates a new one. A column missing from the file is left unchanged (an "id;prix" file only changes prices). No item is deleted. If a single row has an error, nothing is imported.
admin.importChecking: Checking… (up to a minute if the server was asleep)
admin.importHasErrors_one: 1 error: fix the file and choose it again. Nothing was imported.
admin.importHasErrors_other: {{count}} errors: fix the file and choose it again. Nothing was imported.
admin.importPreview: Preview: {{created}} new item(s), {{updated}} changed, {{unchanged}} unchanged. Nothing is saved yet.

importErr.missing_key_column: The file needs an "id" or "nom" column to know which items to update.
importErr.too_many_rows: Line {{line}}: more than {{value}} items, split the file.
importErr.extra_cells: Line {{line}}: more cells than columns (semicolon in an unquoted text?).
importErr.invalid_category: Line {{line}}: unknown category "{{value}}" (Scolaire, Bureau or Livres).
importErr.invalid_price: Line {{line}}: invalid price "{{value}}" (whole number above 0, or empty).
importErr.invalid_stock: Line {{line}}: invalid stock "{{value}}" (whole number, 0 or more).
importErr.invalid_image: Line {{line}}: invalid photo "{{value}}" (local path starting with img/).
importErr.unknown_id: Line {{line}}: no item has id "{{value}}" (leave the id empty to create an item).
importErr.ambiguous_name: Line {{line}}: several items are called "{{value}}"; give the id.
importErr.english_pair: Line {{line}}: fill in both the English name and description, or neither.

admin.fFamilyHelp: Groups items in the catalogue (e.g. Sacs et cartables). Empty = "Other items".

clock.title: Time clock
clock.forgottenHelp: Your clock-in is more than 14 hours old, so the clock-out was probably forgotten. These hours are not counted. Clock out, then ask the manager to correct the time.
clock.breakHelp: Break: clock out when you leave and clock in when you return. Break time is not counted. The server's time is recorded.

hours.intro: Employees' hours, breaks excluded. An entry counts for the day it starts. A missing clock-out (over 14 h) is flagged and not counted until corrected.
hours.noStaff: No employees yet. Give the “Employee” role in the Users tab.
hours.auditNote: The correction is recorded with your account and the date, and stays visible.

orders.intro: Orders and quote requests sent from the site's form (recorded when the customer opens WhatsApp or e-mail, copies or downloads their summary). Always confirm with the customer: a "new" order was not necessarily sent. Stock is not changed.
orders.purgeInfo: Cancelled orders are permanently deleted 30 days after they were cancelled.
